concepts.title: Definition of a Circle
concepts.definition: Mark a fixed point; collect every point sitting exactly one fixed distance from it -- that round curve is a circle, and the fixed distance is its radius.
concepts.key_idea: All points on a circle are equidistant from the center.
question_patterns: All points of a curve sit 4 cm from a fixed centre P -- name the curve.
What is the shape of a curve where all points are 4 cm from a point P?
Define the radius of a circle.
What is the distance between the centre and any point on the circle called?
If a point is on a circle, how does its distance from the centre compare to the radius?
How far is every curve point from the centre?
What name does the fixed middle point of a circle carry?

solution_steps.explain: The fixed distance from the center to any point on the boundary is the radius.
The center is the single fixed point from which every boundary point sits at the same distance.
Every point on the circle is exactly one radius away from the center, which is what makes the curve a circle.

concepts.title: Radius of a Semicircular Wave
concepts.definition: A half circle (semicircle) drawn on a central line segment has a radius equal to half the length of that segment if the segment is the diameter.
concepts.key_idea: A half-round arc squats on a base segment; when that segment is the diameter, the arc's radius is half of it.
question_patterns: What radius should be taken to get a half circle on a segment of 8 cm?
Calculate the radius for a wave where AX is 4 cm.
Find the radius of a semicircular arc given the diameter segment.
A wave arc sits on a 12 cm base -- what radius do you draw?
Find the radius when the base segment measures 10 cm.

solution_steps.explain: The radius of a semicircle is half of its diameter (the segment length).

solution_steps.action: Set the compass opening to the radius
solution_steps.explain: Place the compass point at the midpoint of the segment and open it to the computed radius.

solution_steps.action: Draw the semicircular arc on the segment
solution_steps.explain: Swing the compass from one end of the segment to the other to produce the half-round wave.

concepts.title: Properties of a Rectangle
concepts.definition: A four-sided figure qualifies as a rectangle when matching sides sit across from each other and every corner is 90 degrees.
concepts.key_idea: Matching sides sit across from each other, and every corner is a right angle.
question_patterns: What are the properties of a rectangle?
Is a 4-sided figure with all angles 90 degrees and unequal opposite sides possible?
Verify if a figure is a rectangle based on side lengths and angles.
State the two checks that make a figure a rectangle.
Can a four-sided figure with 90-degree corners fail to be a rectangle?

solution_steps.explain: Verify if AB equals CD and AD equals BC.
Verify if all four angles are exactly 90 degrees.

solution_steps.action: Conclude whether the figure is a rectangle
solution_steps.explain: If both opposite sides are equal and all four angles are 90 degrees, the figure is a rectangle.

concepts.title: Properties of a Square
concepts.definition: A four-sided figure qualifies as a square when the four sides all match and every corner is 90 degrees.
concepts.key_idea: A square is a special rectangle where all four sides are equal.
question_patterns: What makes a figure a square?
List the two main properties of a square.
If all sides are equal but angles are not 90, is it a square?
State the two checks that make a figure a square.
Is a square a special kind of rectangle -- why?

solution_steps.explain: All four sides must be of the same length.
All four angles must be 90 degrees.

solution_steps.action: Conclude whether the figure is a square
solution_steps.explain: If all four sides are equal and all four angles are 90 degrees, the figure is a square -- a special kind of rectangle.

concepts.title: Dividing Rectangles into Identical Squares
concepts.definition: Stack equal squares side by side inside a rectangle: the length must equal the square count times the breadth (each breadth equals one square's side).
concepts.key_idea: The ratio of sides determines how many identical squares fit into a rectangle.
question_patterns: Construct a rectangle that can be divided into 3 identical squares.
If a rectangle is divided into 2 squares of side 4 cm, what is its length?
What must be the length of a rectangle if it is divided into three 5 cm squares?
Draw a rectangle made of 4 equal squares of side 3 cm.
What length suits a rectangle of three squares with 6 cm sides?

solution_steps.action: Identify the side of the square
solution_steps.explain: The breadth of the rectangle is equal to the side of the identical squares.

solution_steps.action: Multiply side by the number of squares
solution_steps.explain: The total length is the sum of the sides of the 'n' squares.
The rectangle has breadth equal to one square's side and length equal to count times the side.

concepts.title: Diagonals of a Rectangle
concepts.definition: Join opposite corners of a rectangle with straight pieces: the two pieces you draw always come out equal in measure.
concepts.key_idea: Both corner-to-corner pieces match in measure, always.
question_patterns: What are the diagonals of a rectangle?
Compare the lengths of the diagonals of a rectangle.
If one diagonal of a rectangle is 7 cm, what is the length of the other?
If one corner-to-corner piece measures 9 cm, how long is the other?
What do the two drawn pieces of a rectangle always share?

solution_steps.explain: In a rectangle, both diagonals have the same measure.
Since both corner-to-corner pieces of a rectangle always match, the second diagonal equals the first.
The other diagonal has the same length as the given one.

concepts.title: Diagonal Angle Bisector in Squares
concepts.definition: In a square, each straight corner-to-corner piece splits the facing 90-degree corner into two equal 45-degree parts.
concepts.key_idea: A rectangle where diagonals bisect the angles is a square.
question_patterns: How does a diagonal divide the angles in a square?
What are the angles formed by a diagonal in a square?
If a diagonal divides a 90 degree angle into two equal parts, what is the measure of each?
What angle does a corner-to-corner piece make with a side of a square?
How much is each part when a square corner is split equally?

solution_steps.explain: The diagonal of a square bisects the 90 degree corner angle.
Splitting 90 degrees equally gives two 45-degree angles.

solution_steps.action: State the angle the diagonal makes with each side
solution_steps.explain: The diagonal meets each side of the square at 45 degrees, confirming the square property.
